text: 2026年10月23日，中国证监会主席吴清会见了香港特别行政区政府财政司司长陈茂波、香港证券及期货事务监察委员会行政总裁梁凤仪。双方就支持香港落实第一个五年规划，进一步深化两地资本市场务实合作、促进协同发展，巩固提升香港国际金融中心地位等议题交换了意见。（证监会网站）
text_en: On October 23, 2026, CSRC Chairman Wu Qing met with Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po and Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission Chief Executive Officer Julia Leung Fung-yee. The two sides exchanged views on supporting Hong Kong in implementing its first five-year plan, further deepening practical cooperation between the two capital markets, promoting coordinated development, and consolidating and enhancing Hong Kong's status as an international financial center. (CSRC website)
